text: He froze the woman he loved, and he did it to save her life.
Alone in the cold, he watches a tiny *dancer* spin inside a snow globe.
The dancer looks like his wife, Nora, and Nora was dying.
No doctor could save her, and Victor wasn't a doctor.
He was a scientist at GothCorp, and his whole job was cold.
So he built a chamber, froze her, and bought himself time to find a cure.
But the company's CEO, Ferris Boyle, cut his funding.
One night, Boyle walked in with two guards and ordered it shut down.
Victor begged. Turning it off meant Nora would die.
Boyle refused, and nobody noticed the little red light blinking in the corner.
Victor fought back, and Boyle kicked him into a table of freezing chemicals.
He survived, but now his body could only live below zero.
And Nora, as far as he knew, was *gone*.
So he built a suit of ice and started tearing GothCorp apart.
Gotham saw a monster in a frozen suit.
Then he came for Boyle at a company ceremony.
He froze Boyle from the waist down.
But Batman stopped him, then showed the city what that red light saw.
It was a security camera, and the tape showed exactly what Boyle did that night.
Now, in Arkham, he holds the little dancer and begs Nora to forgive him.
Gotham calls him Mr. Freeze, but maybe he was never the coldest man in that lab.
